mission: Audit-only (FROZEN) — PricingService SOLID + service composition + immutability snapshot
verdict: GREEN — solid composition, immutable types, single responsibility honored

findings.observation: Class declared `final` + constructor uses readonly typed dependencies with sensible defaults (TaxCalculator, DiscountCalculator, CompositionSnapshotBuilder default-constructed; nullable AvailabilityService / ComposerProfileProjection / ChoiceAvailabilityResolver resolved lazily). DIP respected, testable, no inheritance trap.

PricingRequest is `final` + all public properties are `readonly`. Named static factories `forWeb`/`forPos`/`forTable`/`forKiosk` encapsulate per-surface rounding semantics (POS/Kiosk round line totals + tax + final; web/table preserve high precision). This is the canonical surface differentiator — clean and audit-traceable.

Both DTOs are `final` with `readonly` typed properties — true immutability post-construction. PricingResult exposes `orderItemInsertRows` (bulk-insert ready) + `lines` (rich per-line snapshot). Single source of truth for downstream callers.

Builder is `final` + stateless. SCHEMA_VERSION=1 constant pinned for forward-compat. Snapshot shape is deterministic and serializable. Builder is a pure transformer — no DB writes, no side-effects. Reuses preloaded ItemAttribute collection when provided (N+1 avoidance from PricingService L114-117).

`menuRoleAdjustedAddonPrice` is duplicated verbatim across PricingService and CompositionSnapshotBuilder. The builder docblock (L164-169) explicitly justifies duplication: 'kept local to keep the snapshot builder a pure transformer (no PricingService dep)'. DRY violation traded for layer purity. Acceptable for V1 — but a future shared helper class (e.g. `KioskMenuRatio` value object) would remove the drift risk noted in the comment itself.
findings.recommendation: V1.1 backlog — extract `KioskMenuRatio::adjustedPrice(role, fullPrice)` and inject into both. Today both classes read the same `config('kiosk.menu_pricing')` so observable drift is impossible while config stays the canonical source.

findings.observation: `calculateOrder` is a long method (~200 LOC) but it is procedurally clear, single-pass, deterministic (no time/random except `now()` captured in `created_at` which is metadata, not pricing). No branching on environment, hostname, or non-deterministic state. Each line builds an immutable snapshot via the builder, then mass-insert array is assembled. Round flags come from PricingRequest, not config — clean.

`assertComposerStepConstraints` projects the published ItemWizardProfile (latest active version) and enforces min/max/allow_repeat/availability against payload selections. The projection is delegated to `ComposerProfileProjection` (injected lazily). Versioned mid-cart-rejection contract preserved (cf. ProfilePublishMidCartRejectionTest sibling).

AvailabilityService is consulted in 2 stages: (a) at the top for direct item availability, (b) after addon resolution to recheck addon-item availability. `$orderId > 0` toggles lock-mode (FOR UPDATE during real order creation) vs preview-mode (read-only quote). Sound concurrency contract — preview never holds locks.
Manual discount accepted only for contexts `pos|table`. Kiosk + web contexts cannot inject manualDiscountRequest — enforced by per-surface factory in PricingRequest. Anti-fraud control intact.

Tax-inclusive (TTC) vs HT mode is gated by `config('pricing.tax_inclusive_prices')` (NF525 French default = true, per owner mandate iter15-BUG-NF525 2026-05-10). Branching is local to the totalization step; line-level tax extraction (TaxCalculator::lineTaxAmountFromTTC) is selected upstream at L250. Single, traceable switch — no scattered conditionals.

recommendations_for_v1_1_backlog: Extract `KioskMenuRatio` shared helper to remove duplicate `menuRoleAdjustedAddonPrice` in PricingService + CompositionSnapshotBuilder (P3)
Consider splitting `assertComposerStepConstraints` into its own dedicated `ComposerConstraintEnforcer` to reduce PricingService to <500 LOC (P3 cosmetic)
